d: FOUR OF FIVE AUTHORED, AND ONE CARD IS AN INTEGRITY CLAUSE: "MODIFICATION OF THIS DOCUMENT WITHOUT UPDATING THE CROSS-REFERENCES IN THOSE DEPOSITS CONSTITUTES A PROVENANCE BREAK."
reading:
THE DOCUMENT’S OWN EDITING CONDITION IS WHAT THE LAYER SHOWS. Card 2’s snippet is not argument but GOVERNANCE: a clause declaring that changing the document without updating its cross-references would break provenance, followed by "The holographic kernel above is…". An internal integrity rule, surfaced as the public description of the work.

This is the third such case today, after the ATTRIBUTION CLAUSE on «constitution of the semantic economy installable edition» and the SELF-AUDIT BLOCK on «"Johannine aperture"». The archive writes clauses designed to survive stripping, and those clauses are disproportionately what the layer selects as the snippet. The defensive apparatus is the most retrievable part of the corpus.

Card 5 states the claim the framework rests on: "Contemporary economics HAS NO VOCABULARY for measuring the production, extraction, and depletion of meaning."

The single collision is Tabular Editor on gathering requirements for SEMANTIC MODELS — business-intelligence data modelling, where "semantic model" is a term of art in the analytics stack. A fourth sense of "semantic" in the corpus, after the framework, Semantic Scholar, and semantic web.
transcript: Semantic Economy and the principle of meaning over capital originate from the Constitution of the Semantic Economy. It is a conceptual framework that inverts the traditional relationship between money and meaning.Core ConceptsThe Debt/Creditor Inversion: Traditional economics treats money as the supreme store of value.
